messages:
Alex (New Hire): hey team, i'm Alex — joining eng-runtime this week. quick: who owns GCP quotas, service account scopes, and allowlists for the hosted API? tried the quickstart and got a 403 on generate.
Maya (People Ops): welcome Alex! :tada: short answer: eng-infra for quotas and IAM grants; eng-runtime for API/auth troubleshooting; eng-platform for routing/policy questions. i'll DM you the onboarding checklist and links.
Samir (Eng): +1. For API 403s, capture the curl and request ID. If it's `service-identity-mismatch` it's usually scoping or wrong token.
Alex (New Hire): here's the curl and error:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v1"}'
# response: 403 Forbidden: service-identity-mismatch request_id=abc123
```
Samir (Eng): looks like the token you're using is a demo/sandbox token. Org tokens must include `inference:invoke`.
Elaine (Eng-Infra): i can apply the scope. @Alex please paste the GCP project id and service account email so I can grant the role.
Alex (New Hire): project=redwood-dev-43, svc acct=alex.dev@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Elaine (Eng-Infra): got it. i'll enqueue the grant now, ETA ~15-25m. note: if you're outside 9-5 PT, eng-infra will still process but might be slower. file a ticket with `first-week` tag if it stalls.
Jin (Platform): quick note on escalation: for immediate infra access problems, page eng-infra -> eng-sre if it's impacting multiple people -> oncall rotation. For runtime errors tied to tokens/config, ping eng-runtime first.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Oncall Bot, who is on infra oncall today?
Oncall Bot: Eng-Infra oncall: Priya (primary), Marcus (secondary). Shift: 2026-03-23 07:00 - 2026-03-24 07:00 UTC.
Alex (New Hire): thanks! anything I can do to avoid this in the future?
Samir (Eng): avoid mixing tokens (sandbox vs org), always use the org token for testing against hosted endpoints, and add your home IP to the egress allowlist if you hit network blocks.
Maya (People Ops): also adding you to the "new hires pairing" session at 3pm today where Samir will demo the runtime auth flow.
Elaine (Eng-Infra): grant applied. you should have `inference:invoke` now, test and report back.
Alex (New Hire): confirmed 1: curl works and generate returns 200. thanks all!
Jin (Platform): i'll add a compact owner map to the onboarding doc (eng-infra: quotas/iam, eng-runtime: api/auth, eng-platform: routing/policies, eng-sre: incidents/oncall).
Maya (People Ops): perfect, i'll update the checklist and link to the owner map.
Alex (New Hire): closing thread 1: appreciate the rapid help!
